Name: Textile Shredder - Clothing Recycle Deconstructor - Recycling unused clothes with materials from tailoring or sewing machine
Author: MissAnaira
Description:
Have a dresser or chest overflowing with random clothing you're never going to wear? Well now you can make these clothing items useful by deconstructing them with the textile shredder! This machine can be purchased at Robin's for 5,000g.

Vanilla clothing items are recycled into cloth or whatever materials they were originally made to be tailored with, found on the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Tailoring]wiki[/url].


This mod is currently in beta since the machine's sprite design is unofficial.
Feedback welcomed! i18n is also supported, contact me on Nexus or via Discord: @missanaira

Downloads.Description: Beta due to unofficial machine sprite design.
